stories.summary: Australia’s biggest oil and gas company recorded a 27% increase in sales profit to $1.67bn in the six-month reporting period Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Woodside Energy has scrapped its long-term emissions and clean energy targets, even after enjoying a period of windfall oil profits caused by the Iran conflict. Australia’s biggest oil and gas company recorded a 27% increase in sales profit to $1.67bn ($A2.33bn) in the six-month reporting period, according to financials lodged on Tuesday, after the price of crude surged amid disruptions to global supplies. stories.title: Party radio debates ahead of State Duma elections begin in Russia
stories.summary: MOSCOW, August 25. The first election debates among parties running in the State Duma elections will air today on federal radio stations. Earlier, the Central Election Commission held a draw to allocate free airtime among registered parties on nationwide state television and radio channels. Following the draw, the commission approved a schedule for campaign materials and joint campaign events. Further radio debates will be held on August 26 and 27 and September 1, 2, 8 and 9. Television debates will begin on August 31 and will air on Channel. One, Rossiya-1, Rossiya-24, TV Center and OTR on different days. Elections to the ninth State Duma will take place on September 18, 19 and 20, 2026. Residents of Donbass and Novorossiya will take part in the State Duma elections for the first time. Ten parties are taking part in the elections in the federal constituency: United Russia, the Communist Party, the Liberal Democratic Party, New People, A Just Russia, the Russian Party of Pensioners for Social Justice, Communists of Russia, Rodina, the Russian Ecological Party. The Greens and the Party of Direct Democracy.

stories.title: Damascus expects US to lift all remaining Syria sanctions
stories.summary: "This step marks a significant shift in international relations and creates appropriate conditions for the country's reconstruction and for strengthening security and stability across the region. We expect the United States to lift all remaining restrictions imposed against Damascus," the Syrian Foreign Ministry said in a statement. Earlier, Asaad al-Shaibani, foreign minister in the transitional government, wrote on X that Damascus expected a strategic partnership with Washington to deepen. "We hope that this step will be followed by lifting all restrictions that hinder Syria's reconstruction and its return to its natural role in the Arab and international arenas," he said.

stories.summary: Three boys, two aged 14 and one aged 13, on bail and yet to enter a plea after alleged assault in Sydney’s east Three teenage boys from an elite Sydney private school who allegedly raped a 14-year-old girl in an alleyway in Sydney’s eastern suburbs have faced court for the first time. On Tuesday, the three boys, two aged 14 and one aged 13, from Sydney’s Scots College had their matter heard in Surry Hills Children’s Court, but remained outside the courtroom. Continue reading...
